entities.name: farmer standing behind the hedge by the bare trees
entities.what: Adult man, a farmer of the farmstead, standing at the east end of the shrub belt west of the farmhouse, just in front of the pale trunk S1.tree.pale_trunk_34474 and west of the twin elm S1.tree.bare_elm_twin_34552: a small hat or hooded cap, a plain robe or long jacket, the hands held together at the chest (in the sleeves); body turned toward the viewer, the head a little to the west. Only the upper body shows above the bushes.
entities.vis: part: legs hidden by the shrub belt S1.str.hedge_yard_34265
entities.note: Head and hat outline u 34462-34482, v 762-782; body visible to v ~819 (u 34460-34487), below that the bushes. Foot est from the visible part (head to waist ~55 px, so about 120-125 px tall) and the ground line behind the bushes (the bushes' foot is at v ~920). Painted height est 123 px. The restyle draws one standing figure here too (u ~34440-34470, v 780-850), offset ~20 px west. No second figure beside him: the dark strokes at u 34500-34505 are the elm's trunk.

entities.name: figure bending under the threshing-floor shed (uncertain)
entities.what: A dark hooked shape under the open shed at the threshing floor, behind the long low plank S1.prop.long_plank_shed_35060: read as a person crouching or bending forward over the plank, seen from behind, a hood or cap at the top. It could also be a tool or a straw raincoat hung on the shed's post.
entities.note: Strokes: a curved stroke from (35097, 790) up to (35105, 768) and over to (35120, 773), with a dark blob at (35107-35117, 787-797); nothing below v ~805 (the plank's line). The restyle draws a standing man in a dark robe here (u 35108-35128, v 757-793) working behind a long table. Painted height 67 px to the est foot, about half the farmer at 34472 (123 px), so if it is a person he is crouching or bending. Both readings: a crouching farmer, or a hung object (then retire this entity). The restyle's other people in this yard (two standing men at u 35040-35090 v 840-910, a seated man at ~34990, a man with a donkey at 35270-35300) are not in the strokes. SECOND PASS (farms): the same strokes were also S1.str.posts_35075's east post (see that entity). The figure reading is the stronger one: an inverted V of indigo-tinted strokes, apex (35105, 760), feet of the V at (35093, 795) and (35118, 800), with a dark mass in its east half. The garment colour and the lack of any shaft below v 800 rule out a post. It reads as a person in a dark cloak or hood, crouching or bending behind the plank, seen from behind. The dark mass at (35095-35115, 815-831) is his lower body or a jar beside the jar S1.prop.jar_shed_35058. conf stays low (a hung straw cape is still possible).

entities.name: bare elm with two stems and a crow's nest, west of the farmhouse
entities.what: Bare elm-like tree (elm_claw form) with no leaves: two stems from one foot; the west stem leans and curves north-west to a crown of dark crab-claw twigs with a crow's nest (a dark tangled clump) at about (34445, 393); the east stem rises nearly upright to about (34525, 420) and spreads east. Early spring, bare. Stands just behind (north of) the ground line at the front of the farmstead, among the shrub belt.
entities.vis: part: lower trunk among the shrubs
entities.note: Trunk outlines at the foot u 34535 and 34568, ending at v 935-937 on the dark ground line (v 933-947). The west stem passes (34550, 720), (34520, 595), (34480, 470) to the nest (34435-34455, 380-405); the east stem passes (34510-34540, 430-640). Painted height foot to crown top 664 px. Its crown's west twigs interlace with the long level branches of a big spreading tree whose trunks stand at u ~34000-34120 (t5's), so crown_w is est. The nest is part of the tree (no bird painted on it). MERGE: its nest is the prop S1.prop.nest_34445.

entities.name: bare elm with two stems between the farmhouse trees
entities.what: Bare elm-like tree (elm_claw form), smaller: two stems from one foot, the west one curving up and slightly west, the east one straight, to a small crown of crab-claw twigs at about v 420-560 between the crowns of S1.tree.bare_elm_twin_34552 and the tall elm S1.tree.bare_elm_tall_34703. Early spring, bare.
entities.vis: part: crown interlaced with the neighbours' crowns; lower stems among the shrubs and in front of the domed thatch roof
entities.note: Foot lines at u 34623-34633 and 34647-34657 ending at v ~935-937. West stem at u ~34600 at v 560 curving down to the foot; east stem at u 34647-34665 from v 490 to the foot. Painted height ~516 px. Which twigs are its own and which belong to 34552 or 34703 is uncertain, so crown_w and crown_e are est.

entities.name: tall bare elm with two crow's nests over the farmhouse
entities.what: The tallest of the farmstead's bare trees (elm_claw form): a straight slender trunk rising from behind the shrubs at the farmhouse's west end to a high crown of dark crab-claw twigs, with a crow's nest at the top (about (34680, 290)) and a second nest on a long branch reaching east over the farmhouse roof (about (34757, 350)). Early spring, bare.
entities.vis: part: foot hidden by the shrubs S1.str.fence_brush_34660
entities.note: Trunk edges u 34693-34720 at v 600-700, u 34684 and 34726 at v 860; the foot is hidden in the bushes, est at the ground line (v ~925-935). Nests: (34670-34690, 280-300) and (34750-34765, 343-360). The east branch reaches (34905, 362) over the back roof; a lower east branch reaches about (34835, 470). Painted height ~682 px. MERGE: its two nests are the props S1.prop.nest_34680 and S1.prop.nest_34757.

entities.name: pale straight trunk behind the farmer (far tree?)
entities.what: A tall straight trunk drawn only in pale outline (two faint lines about 33 px apart, plain silk between), rising from behind the shrub belt to about v 490, where it disappears among the elm's twigs; no crown of its own shows. Read as a slender bare tree (slender form) standing a little behind the hedge, drawn pale; it could be a willow whose crown is lost in the faded silk.
entities.vis: part: foot hidden by the shrubs; top lost among the twigs of S1.tree.bare_elm_twin_34552
entities.note: Trunk about 33-36 px wide, centre u ~34465 at v 500 and ~34474 at v 860. Outline lines at u 34443-34453 and 34468-34483 (v 500), 34453-34456 and 34492-34501 (v 600), 34456-34459 and 34492 (v 860); nothing at v 905-920 (the foot is behind the bushes). The restyle draws a tall thin trunk here too, with an invented green weeping-willow crown. The farmer S1.fig.farmer_by_hedge_34472 stands in front of its east edge.

entities.name: faint thin trunk west of the pale trunk (uncertain)
entities.what: A second, thinner pale vertical trunk line just west of S1.tree.pale_trunk_34474, from behind the shrub belt up to about v 495: a slender far tree (slender form), drawn very faint.
entities.note: Pale strip with darker edges at u 34407-34418 between v ~500 and ~880 (column profile: dark at 34412-34418 at v 650-700). Could be a crease in the silk rather than a trunk: both readings; if a crease, retire it.

entities.name: pollarded willow over the threshing-floor shed
entities.what: Pollarded willow (willow_fan form) beside the threshing floor: a pale, slightly twisted trunk rises behind the open shed to a big knobbly pollard head of several dark knobs (u ~35130-35290, v 590-680), from which a broad fan of long shoots springs up and out; on the east side the shoots arch over and hang down toward the floor. Early spring, bare or a faint haze. The largest tree of the farmyard's east end.
entities.vis: part: lower trunk and foot hidden behind the shed's thatch and posts
entities.note: Trunk seen at u 35112-35150, v 650-735 (pale, dark-edged), under the west knob (35127-35160, 600-660); below v ~735 it goes behind the shed's roof, so the foot is est straight below, at the ground behind the shed's front posts. A pale tapering sheaf of parallel strokes at u 35203-35240, v 673-790 hangs from the main knob: read as a bunch of drooping shoots; the restyle reads it as a second, thick trunk (drawn ~50 px further east, to a foot at ~(35300, 860) where the scan is plain silk). If it is a second trunk, its foot is about (35235, 795). Fainter, pale shoots west of u 35020 over the back roof (to about (34900, 520)) converge on their own point at about (34995, 598): the second pass maps them as a separate far willow, S1.tree.far_willow_34995 (low). Painted height foot est to top 368 px.

entities.name: far willow crown above the farmyard willow (uncertain)
entities.what: A faint, rounded crown of fine shoots drawn in pale ink above the pollarded willow's fan: read as a farther willow (willow_fan, drawn small and pale) standing behind the farmstead, its trunk hidden by the willow and the roofs.
entities.vis: part: trunk and foot hidden; crown faint
entities.note: Crown strokes u 35048-35246, v 348-486, lighter than the near willow's fan (which tops out at v ~444). Both readings: a separate far tree (as recorded), or the near willow's back shoots drawn pale (then retire this). Base est below the crown behind the back roof. The restyle paints invented green weeping willows here.

entities.name: bench on the threshing floor
entities.what: A low wooden bench (or low table) standing on the threshing floor in front of the open shed: a plank top with a block leg at each end, set east-west. The brief's hint of a stone roller here is not borne out: the strokes show legs and open silk under the top, not a cylinder.
entities.note: SCALE CUE: top 35100-35165 at v 837-842 (65 px long), legs u 35103-35120 and 35150-35163, feet at v 865-870; about 30 px tall at foot v 868. DEPTH DIRECTION: none (seen square-on). The restyle draws a bench here too. The shed's front post at u ~35150 comes down just behind its east leg.

entities.name: long low plank (bench or trough) under the shed
entities.what: A long low plank under the open shed, running east-west along its back: a bench, a low table or a trough. A dark round object stands under its middle (S1.prop.jar_shed_35058).
entities.note: Line at v 803-812 from u ~35006 to 35110; its legs or feet are not clear (base est at mid-length a little below the line). Both readings: a long bench or trough (prop), or the shed's sill or back wall (structures_e's: then retire this). The restyle reads a long table with pots on it.

entities.name: dark round object under the shed (jar or basket)
entities.what: A small dark rounded object on the ground under the long plank in the shed: a jar, a basket or a bundle.
entities.note: Dark blob at u 35050-35067, v 815-830. The restyle draws pots and jars here (u 35030-35090, v 780-840). About 17 px wide.

entities.name: row of short hatched strokes lying on the floor (broom, rake or straw)
entities.what: A long thin band of short slanted strokes lying flat on the threshing floor east of the bench: a long broom or a wooden rake laid down, or a strip of straw swept to the floor's edge.
entities.note: Band from u 35162 to 35250 at v 857-868, ticks slanting down-right. Both readings: a tool lying down (prop), or straw marking the threshing floor's edge (part of structures_e's S1.grd threshing floor). The restyle does not draw it.

entities.name: slatted box at the farmhouse front (crate or coop)
entities.what: A small box with horizontal slats between two upright sides, standing under the east end of the front farmhouse's eave: a crate, a chicken coop or a rack.
entities.note: Box u 34940-34980, v 815-843 (three slats at about v 817, 827, 837), an upright line at u 34943 from v 800. Both readings: a free-standing crate or coop (prop), or a lattice window or gate in the house front or yard fence (structures_e's: then retire this). The restyle paints a standing woman over it (invented).

entities.name: frame of crossed poles in front of the farmhouse
entities.what: A low frame of crossed and slanting poles on the ground in front of the farmhouse, west of the slatted box: a trestle or drying rack, or a farm tool (a harrow or a ladder) leaning.
entities.note: Diagonal strokes from (34907, 827) to (34937, 860) and from (34906, 842) to (34953, 866), legs to v ~880-883. Both readings: a prop (as recorded) or the crossed lattice of a yard fence (structures_e's). The restyle draws a wooden fence with diagonal braces here.

entities.name: stack of things under the farmhouse eave
entities.what: A low stack of horizontal things under the front farmhouse's eave, between its west post and the crossed poles: stacked baskets, boards or firewood.
entities.note: Rows of short horizontal strokes at u 34830-34890, v 822-845. Both readings: a stack set down by the house (prop), or the top rail of a yard fence (structures_e's). The restyle draws a stack of pots here with seated people beside it (the people are not in the strokes).

entities.name: crow's nest in the west crown of the twin elm
entities.what: A dark tangled clump of twigs in a fork of the bare elm's west stem: a crow's nest. No bird is painted on it.
entities.note: MERGE: from t6's S1.tree.bare_elm_twin_34552 note (nest at (34435-34455, 380-405)); base = its bottom. t5 saw the same nest from its side ("a nest at (34440, 390)"). Recorded as a perched prop like t5's S1.prop.nest_33900.

entities.name: crow's nest at the top of the tall elm
entities.what: A dark tangled clump of twigs at the top of the tall bare elm: a crow's nest. No bird is painted on it.
entities.note: MERGE: from t6's S1.tree.bare_elm_tall_34703 note (nest at (34670-34690, 280-300)); base = its bottom. Recorded as a perched prop like t5's S1.prop.nest_33900.

entities.name: crow's nest on the tall elm's east branch
entities.what: A second dark tangled clump of twigs on the tall bare elm's long east branch over the farmhouse roof: a crow's nest. No bird is painted on it.
entities.note: MERGE: from t6's S1.tree.bare_elm_tall_34703 note (nest at (34750-34765, 343-360)); base = its bottom. Recorded as a perched prop like t5's S1.prop.nest_33900.
